title: Rory and the Lavender Hill
verses:
The sun dipped away as the evening grew still,
And Rory walked up to the lavender hill.
The blossoms were folding beneath the pink sky,
As sleepy cloud blankets went wandering by.

Then Nia came gliding on wings soft and slow,
Above the calm river that rippled below.
And Ricky hopped over a moss-covered log,
Through ribbons of silver and shimmering fog.

Now Tilly stepped softly across the cool ground,
Where dew on the clover was heavy and round.
And Benny let out a contented, soft hum,
And knew that the hour for resting had come.

Then Psittaco tucked in a cradle of green,
The coziest burrow that ever was seen.
And Rory curled down with a slumbery yawn,
To rest until morning would welcome the dawn.

With heads tucked together the happy friends lay,
Remembering all of the joy in their day.
A blanket of starlight was spread from above,
To wrap the whole meadow in comfort and love.

The hillside is quiet, the breezes blow light,
While fireflies glitter across the soft night.
So close your eyes, dreamer, let rest settle deep,
For Rory and friends are now drifting to sleep.
